# Conversive — Care Conversations AI Platform
> Conversive is a leading Care Conversations AI platform that helps healthcare providers deliver 24/7 patient engagement, reduce no-shows, streamline intake, and maintain HIPAA-compliant communication across SMS, WhatsApp, voice, and email.

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://conversive.ai/): Overview of Conversive's AI-powered patient engagement platform
- [Book a Demo](https://conversive.ai/demo.html): Schedule a personalized demo session
- [Blogs](https://conversive.ai/blogs.html): Healthcare AI, journey orchestration, and patient communication insights

## Blog Articles
- [The Future of Patient Communication in Clinical Environments](https://conversive.ai/future-of-patient-communication-in-clinical-environment.html): How Conversive helps bridge language, cultural, and infrastructure gaps in healthcare messaging
- [Journey Builder Guide: Building Effective Customer Journeys in 2026](https://conversive.ai/journey-builder-guide.html): Strategic guide to designing human-centered customer journeys with AI

- [Voice-First Is No Longer Optional. It's Structural.](https://conversive.ai/voice-first-is-no-longer-optional-it%27s-structural.html): Why voice-first conversational AI is becoming core infrastructure

## Product Capabilities
- 24/7 Digital Front Desk — AI agents handling patient inquiries round the clock
- Appointment Booking & Reminders — Direct EHR-integrated scheduling with automated reminders
- No-Show Handling — Re-engagement workflows for missed appointments
- Patient Intake — Secure pre-visit data collection via SMS/WhatsApp
- Ongoing Care & Follow-up — Post-visit guidance and check-in sequences
- Reviews & Feedback — Automated patient satisfaction workflows
- HIPAA / HITECH compliance — End-to-end encryption, audit logs, consent tracking
